caption:
Meta has launched Muse, a personal AI agent designed to assist users in various tasks. Muse operates on a secure virtual machine, utilizing advanced features to enhance productivity and ensure privacy. With capabilities like booking appointments and filling out forms, it aims to streamline everyday activities. 

What tasks would you want a personal AI to handle for you? 

Sources: Meta
